description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rico Dowdle practiced again on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dowdle remains on track to return on Sunday. Jaylen Warren is expected to remain in his lead role in the Steelers backfield.
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DeShon Elliott was practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Elliott will have a chance to be activated from injured reserve for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
items.title: DeShon Elliott (knee) practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jamel Dean returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Dean was sidelined this past week. He'll have a chance to return on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
items.title: Jamel Dean (ankle) back at practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Broncos S Talanoa Hufanga is set to miss multiple weeks with an ankle injury.
items.impact: The Broncos secondary will remain short-handed for at least another couple of weeks.
items.title: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) to miss multiple weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Antoine Winfield Jr. remained absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Winfield remains week-to-week.
items.title: Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tristan Wirfs was practicing with a brace on his right knee on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wirfs will need to be monitored on the official injury report on Wednesday.
items.title: Tristan Wirfs practicing with knee brace Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sean Tucker was seen working off to the side during practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear what Tucker is dealing with. He will need to be monitored when the official injury report is released.
items.title: Sean Tucker works off to side during practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Baker Mayfield remains absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Mayfield remains unlikely to return in Week 6.
items.title: Baker Mayfield (thumb) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Carson Schwesinger was seen wearing a walking boot at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is unclear if it is precautionary. Schwesinger remains day-to-day for now.
items.title: Carson Schwesinger (ankle) in walking boot

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Browns head coach Todd Monken said there's a "chance" Dylan Sampson could play Sunday.
items.impact: Sampson will return to practice this week. He should be activated either this week or next week.
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) 'has a chance' to play Sunday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) did not take part in Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: Judkins sustained an ankle injury in Week 5 and was already considered day-to-day. He was seen walking around in a boot Wednesday, which is obviously of some concern regarding Sunday's matchup against the Ravens. Judkins should be monitored this week. If he can't go, Raheim Sanders and Jaleel McLaughlin should split most of the carries.
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) not practicing Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Caleb Williams is slated to practice in full on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is another step in the right direction for Williams. He will have a chance to return on Sunday against the Falcons.
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) to practice in full Wednesday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: KC Concepcion Jr. (concussion) took part in Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: Concepcion is in the concussion protocol, but Wednesday's activity certainly looks promising for his availability in Week 6. If Concepcion cannot go, Jerry Jeudy and Isaiah Bond will see more snaps.
items.title: KC Concepcion Jr. (concussion) practices Wednesday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) took part in Wednesday's practice session.
items.impact: Penix sustained a rib injury late in Sunday night's loss to the Ravens. After an MRI earlier this week, the young QB's injury was not considered long-term. Penix's involvement at all in Wednesday's practice is certainly a positive sign.
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (ribs) practices Wednesday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Braden Smith (foot) will be active for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Smith has yet to play this season. He was reportedly close to being activated for last Sunday's game , but the Texans waited one more week. After eight seasons with the Colts, Smith will make his debut for the Texans on Sunday.
items.title: Braden Smith (foot) activated from IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said David Quessenberry will start at left tackle for the Rams.
items.impact: Quessenberry will get the opportunity with Alaric Jackson suspended.
items.title: David Quessenberry to start at left tackle for Rams

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Keagen Trost will return to practice this week.
items.impact: Trost suffered a hamstring injury during the preseason. He'll have 21 days to officially be activated.
items.title: Keagen Trost (hamstring) to return to practice this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Rams head coach Sean McVay said the Rams will not start Myles Garrett's clock this week.
items.impact: Garrett remains week-to-week to return from injured reserve.
items.title: Myles Garrett (knee) will not return to practice this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins worked out TE Messiah Swinson.
items.impact: Swinson will compete to earn a depth role in the Dolphins tight end room.
items.title: Messiah Swinson works out for Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins worked out RB Jerome Ford.
items.impact: Ford was recently released by the Dolphins.
items.title: Jerome Ford works out for Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Dolphins worked out CB Cobee Bryant.
items.impact: Bryant previously worked out for the Packers. He will likely sign with a team soon.
items.title: Cobee Bryant works out for Dolphins

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Free agent OL Jamaree Salyer visited the Arizona Cardinals on Tuesday.
items.impact: Salyer had his knee scoped in August and is now fully healthy. He is expected to sign with a team in the coming weeks.
items.title: Jamaree Salyer visits Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals worked out WR Joaquin Davis.
items.impact: Davis was one of two wide receivers to work out for Arizona following the Marvin Harrison Jr. trade.
items.title: Joaquin Davis works out for Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cardinals worked out WR Courtney Jackson.
items.impact: Jackson was one of two wide receivers to work out for Arizona following the Marvin Harrison Jr. trade.
items.title: Courtney Jackson works out for Cardinals

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings hosted WR Dee Eskridge.
items.impact: Eskridge was most recently with the Dolphins.
items.title: Dee Eskridge works out for Vikings
